notes.title: Magma Trails Patch 3
notes.content:
Gameplay

Added gamepad support for UI. Players should be able to navigate the game using just a controller across all panels (except the Settings menu). 

Performance

Added a DirectX 11 Option in Settings which should help anyone experiencing poor performance or crashing. This mostly affected older raytracing GPUs and some AMD GPUs. 

Leaderboards

Added a ranking number and score to the UI scene. 

Leaderboards are now cached locally and should be more responsive when paging through. 

Controls

Added an invert Y option. 

Bug Fixes

Players can now access the Esc Menu on the login screen as well as the post game / score screen.

notes.title: FOAD v0.1.0.3499
notes.content:
Magma Trials Patch 2 🔥🧪
Gameplay

 ⚡ Power Meter starts charging on match start. Previously it would charge a small amount during the level overview cutscenes.
 🏆 Added several new categories to flavor rankings on Score Screen for scores greater than $200k.
 💰 Made additional improvements to Shrine Bonus logic. Now it should always register the bonus money after the match.
 💸 Money that is picked up during the two second “Times Up” window is counted toward your final score. (This mainly affected falling money from shrine destruction and money picked up right at 0:00).
 🔫 Adjusted Ultimate respawning to more effectively respawn players in tighter corridors without sending them back to the start.
 🪨 Tweaked the rock colliders for better player detection and movement.
 🚀 Optimization pass on lighting and materials has been done to further increase FPS.
 🎨 Switched rendering from Shader Model 6 to Shader Model 5 to address some issues with AMD GPUs.

Leaderboards

 📈 Added a Total Score Leaderboard that tracks the cumulative amount of all completed runs. We’ve been tracking this data since launch so your score should reflect this.
 🔍 Slightly increased font size for readability.
 💬 Added FOAD next to the Leaderboard so it wouldn’t be lonely.

Settings

 🖱️ Added a Mouse Sensitivity slider. We’ve tried to tune the default close to the previous builds settings. Current players may need to hit the “Apply” button for this update to apply correctly on first load of the game.
 ❌ Removed Motion Blur option. Looked like ass when enabled tbh.
